old_description: Avon Lake Sheet Metal Company, Inc. has been family-owned and operated since 1953 and conveniently located in Avon Lake, about 25 miles outside of Cleveland. As a leader in metal fabrication, we fabricate high-quality products to suit your needs, while also offering on-site installation and plant maintenance services to our customers, with safety always being one of our top priorities.
about:
Avon Lake Sheet Metal Company, Inc. has been family-owned and operated since 1953 in Avon Lake, Ohio, about 25 miles west of Cleveland. The business began in a one-car garage when founders George Wightman and Carl Wetzig Sr. established the shop on principles of honesty and hard work. Second-generation owners Carl Wetzig Jr. and Gary Wightman continue to lead the company today.

The company runs a 32,000-square-foot facility on a five-acre industrial site equipped with modern machinery including a Trumpf TruLaser 2030 4,000-watt fiber laser, a Trumpf TruBend 2100 press brake, a Wysong 12-foot 175-ton hydraulic press brake, a Lockformer Vulcan 2900 dual-table CNC plasma cutter, and a Fasti FP60 CNC panel former. Core capabilities span sheet metal fabrication (CNC laser, plasma, and shear cutting; CNC press brake forming and panel folding; rolling), structural fabrication (sawing, punching, drilling), certified welding (MIG, TIG, stick, flux core, pulsed MIG, spot, field), assembly of mechanical components and modules, finishing (painting, laser etching, glass beading, grinding), and 3D modeling with Inventor and AutoCAD. Field services cover equipment installation, field welding, plant maintenance, project management, and coordination drawings. The shop also provides turnkey HVAC system design, duct fabrication, and installation, plus custom machine guarding fabrication and installation.

Avon Lake Sheet Metal serves a diverse customer base across automotive, steel and foundry, chemical, plastics, construction, food processing, general manufacturing, retail, education, and health care industries. The company also works with medical groups, industrial mills, and bulk powder material handling systems.

The founders' original emphasis on honesty, hard work, and lasting value remains central. The company states its core values as quality, efficiency, and integrity, and highlights a safety-first culture recognized by multiple SMACNA Zero Injury Awards (2015, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2022). AWS-certified welders and a drug-free workplace certification further underscore its operational standards.

name: Axial Medical
old_description: From prototype to production, Axial Medical can support all of your medical device manufacturing needs. A partnership with Axial will get your products into the field on time and on budget.
about:
Axial Medical operates a 40,000-square-foot facility in Warminster, Pennsylvania, just outside Philadelphia. The purpose-built plant was completed in 2014 to serve the medical device industry.

The company provides medical device manufacturing from prototype through production, specializing in 5-axis CNC milling, wire EDM, gun drilling, and assembly. Its shop houses over 60 5-axis CNC machines (including MAZAK, HAAS, and CHIRON mills) and FANUC wire EDMs capable of 72-hour unmanned runs. Processes hold tolerances of ±0.0001 inch and are supported by optical/video inspection and automated SPC data collection.

Axial serves medical device OEMs, producing components such as expandable implants and cannulated products. The company offers vendor-managed inventory programs and environmentally controlled assembly areas for finished devices.

Axial differentiates itself with ISO 13485:2016 certification, FDA registration, full in-house process validations, and a focus on risk mitigation and continuous improvement. Automation and robotics are employed to increase throughput and part-per-bar yield.

about:
Axiom Manufacturing is based in Richardson, Texas, and has been producing electronics in the United States since 1992. The company operates as a privately held business; no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed publicly.

The company provides printed circuit board assembly (surface-mount and through-hole with automated optical inspection), custom RF circuit design and integration up to 40 GHz, full box-build and electromechanical assembly, cable and harness fabrication, and a suite of environmental, functional, and reliability testing to military standards. Axiom reports more than one million units delivered to over 500 customers with a 98 percent on-time delivery rate across three decades of operation.

Its customer base spans aerospace and defense (mission-critical systems for aviation, space, and defense), industrial (ruggedized electronics for harsh environments), medical (FDA-compliant devices and diagnostic equipment), and telecommunications (high-frequency RF solutions for wireless infrastructure).

Axiom states that its differentiation lies in delivering mission-critical electronic assemblies and RF solutions with unmatched reliability and precision, backed by domestic manufacturing since 1992 and testing protocols aligned with military requirements.

old_description: Our parent company, Custom Tool & Die, Inc., began in a small garage in 1979. We incorporated the following year and became official in April of 1980. What began as a small tool and die shop has grown into a large metal fabrication, tool and die, and manufacturing plant. about:
Axles Plus, operating as the axle-assembly division of Custom Tool & Die, Inc., is based in Beebe, Arkansas. The parent company began in a small garage in 1979 and incorporated in April 1980, growing from a tool-and-die shop into a full-scale metal fabrication and manufacturing plant on Highway 5 near Cabot since 1982. The business remains third-generation family-owned and operated. In May 2015 the Axles Plus brand was launched in Ward, AR, and in 2017 the operation moved to its current Beebe location where axle assemblies are built and a retail store serves walk-in customers.

The company produces trailer axles, components, and accessories—including hardware kits, spring latch assemblies, and a range of nuts, bolts, and shackle straps. Production centers on CNC machining, laser cutting, metal fabrication, stamping, and custom manufacturing, allowing the shop to handle both small specialty projects and larger production runs. The facility also prepares trucks for in-state and out-of-state delivery.

Axles Plus serves the trailer industry, supplying equipment trailers, travel trailers, horse trailers, and other trailer types. Customers include individual trailer owners who visit the retail showroom for parts such as tongue hitches, trailer jacks, bearings, LED lights, and bulk tires and wheels, as well as commercial trailer builders needing custom axle assemblies.

The company emphasizes that customer service is its top goal and that quality is never optional, combining modern technology with American-made craftsmanship to deliver dependable products. It highlights its ability to adapt and invest in advanced production capabilities while maintaining the values that shaped the business.

about:
Axon Medical Technologies is based in New Cumberland, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 2003 by Michael Zarreii, who serves as chief executive and chief scientific officer. Zarreii began the venture as a philanthropic effort to explore the connection between the brain’s involuntary sensory functions and cognition, aiming to develop advanced diagnostic and therapeutic devices.

The company designs and manufactures two primary platforms: ECAT™, a point-of-care multi-screening system for primary care clinics, and Intellig-EYES™, a neurological performance measurement headgear. Both are produced in an FDA-registered facility in the United States. The platforms automate assessments such as pupillometry, cognitive testing (Trail Making Test, GPCOG, MMSE, CAPS-5), and rapid concussion screening. Axon Medical is currently expanding its manufacturing capacity to serve both commercial and military markets.

The technology targets primary care and family practice clinics, as well as military healthcare settings. The U.S. Army has funded a four-year study to integrate ECAT and Intellig-EYES into treatment protocols for service members. The platforms also support sports medicine through sideline concussion detection. Customers include clinic owners and healthcare providers who lease the devices under a per-scan billing model with CPT code reimbursement.

Zarreii’s original vision was to solve complex neurological challenges through non-invasive, objective, and automated testing. The company differentiates itself with portable, lightweight devices that generate real-time, color-coded results and clinical documentation, all while minimizing financial risk for providers through a leasing structure rather than direct sales.

name: B & H Sheet Metal
old_description: Custom Fabrication of Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminum and Copper.
about:
B & H Sheet Metal operates from Asheville, North Carolina, where it has served Western North Carolina since 1976. The company is a second-generation, family-owned and operated fabrication shop that began with rolling, bending, punching, press brake forming, and shearing work.

The shop provides full-service custom sheet metal fabrication, including welding, for both residential and commercial customers. It works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and galvanized steel, producing items such as custom chimney caps and stainless steel countertops. All work is custom fabricated; no pre-fabricated products are offered. The facility's capacity, headcount, and annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

Customers include homeowners and contractors throughout Western North Carolina. Typical projects range from residential chimney caps and countertops to commercial fabrication needs. The company emphasizes that no job is too big or too small.

The family ownership stresses pride in material quality and workmanship, offering a warranty on all work and free consultations. They position themselves on competitive pricing and the ability to deliver parts when needed, backed by over 40 years of experience.

name: B & L Scales, Inc.
old_description: B&L Scales, Inc was founded in 1976 by C. Leroy McBride. Leroy began by traveling the state on his Goldwing Motorcycle, pulling a tiny trailer with his tools and necessities; visiting customers, servicing scales and machines, and building his business one stop at a time.
about:
B & L Scales, Inc. is based in Billings, Montana, and was founded in 1976 by C. Leroy McBride. McBride started the business by traveling across the state on a Goldwing motorcycle with a small trailer of tools, visiting customers and servicing scales and equipment. The company remains family-owned and is now operated by John and Nikki McFerran, with Nikki managing daily operations and John continuing semi-annual service routes across Montana, Wyoming, and parts of Colorado.

The company sells and services a wide range of weighing equipment, from gram-capacity bench scales to truck and rail scales, along with scale indicators. It also supplies meat processing machinery such as grinders, mixers, slicers, smokers, vacuum packers, and associated supplies including cutlery, labels, and seasonings. Technicians hold state licenses in Montana and Wyoming for scale calibration, certification, repair, and placing-in-service reports.

Customers include meat processors, delis, ranchers, grocers, farmers’ markets, taxidermists, industrial plants, and individual buyers throughout Montana and Wyoming. The business participates in regional groups such as the Montana Meat Processors Association and the Montana Taxidermist Association.

B & L Scales emphasizes hands-on, on-site support — a tradition dating to its founding — with a policy of servicing both the equipment it sells and equipment from other sources. The company also acts as an authorized distributor and service representative for several scale and processing equipment brands.

about:
B J Plastic Molding Co Inc operates from Franklin Park, Illinois, where it has manufactured rigid plastic boxes and containers since its founding in 1968. The company produces all of its products within its own U.S.

The company specializes in molding rigid plastic boxes and containers, offering more than 130 stock sizes. Its capabilities include custom imprinting, hot stamping, pad printing (including UPC bar codes), and die-cut information cards that extend through the back of the box for rack display. On-site color and process consultation services are also available. All items are designed, created, manufactured, and decorated in the United States, and the facility holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

B J Plastic Molding serves customers seeking reusable and recyclable rigid plastic packaging solutions. Its boxes are used to protect and enhance products while providing a reusable container after the initial product is consumed, an alternative to blister or clamshell packaging.

The company emphasizes domestic production and a full-service approach from design through decoration, positioning its reusable containers as a way to increase sales, reduce packaging costs, and minimize product damage.

name: B&M International Steel Company

about:
B&M International Steel is based in Haymarket, Virginia, and was founded in 2013. The company is family-owned and operated, with leadership that includes CEO Adam Brin and COO Stefan Brin.

The firm provides structural steel fabrication, erection, detailing, 3D laser scanning, and building information modeling (BIM) including 3D and 4D modeling services. It serves projects throughout the Mid-Atlantic region, delivering fabricated steel components and on-site erection for commercial and industrial construction.

Its customers are primarily in the construction sector, including general contractors, architects, and project managers. Testimonials on the company’s site reference a contractor, an architect, and a project manager who have used B&M’s services for building projects.

The company emphasizes its three decades of combined industry experience and the use of advanced BIM and scanning technology to reduce errors, avoid delays, and keep projects on schedule. A customer-centric approach and reliable project delivery are cited as core differentiators.

about:
B & M Sheet Metal Shop, Inc. has been a family-owned fixture in Roanoke, Virginia since 1955. The business was founded by Wallace Leedy Martin, Edith Martin, and Marion Bartley, then led for decades by Wallace Lee Martin before passing to the current owner, Luke McVey Martin.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication services including laser cutting, bending, shearing, plasma cutting, welding, and press brake forming. It produces ductwork, commercial kitchen hoods, and refurbishes stainless steel elevators, and maintains an inventory of stainless steel, carbon steel, aluminum, galvanized, galvanneal, copper, and brass sheet as well as flat bar, angle, tubing, and solid rod.

B & M serves commercial and industrial customers who need measured, fabricated, and installed sheet metal assemblies, offering turnkey service from on-site measurement through final installation and providing quotes before any work begins.

The company emphasizes a hands-on approach, handling the entire project lifecycle in-house — from taking field measurements to fabricating and installing the finished product — which allows it to control quality and scheduling for each job.
